note: Re-vendored at v1.22.0. LYRICS_PREVIEW_TEXT is untouched and is still the only fixture. v1.22.0 is one fix and it is a contract this repo is the other half of: sanitizeSongAssets refused any asset name carrying a separator, so every video assigned from a per-song directory was silently dropped on the way into visuals.json. `assetNameIsRelative` in `visualsFile.ts` is `mapper/assetName.js`, against the same cases.
